root_cause: Instagram had strong Mira/media gates but no immutable ex-ante winner entity. Media materialization could independently pick the current highest recommendation, artifact generation could use another fallback recommendation, and social_posts normalization could inherit an old experiment recipe and classify a Reel as carousel. That broke recommendation-to-outcome lineage even when identity/media safety worked.
prevention_rule: Exactly one immutable Instagram Mira daily winner is persisted before media generation. Media jobs, content artifacts, publish capabilities and social_posts must all carry the same recommendation_id and score_version. The media job winner format is authoritative for provider routing/readback normalization; a publish capability fails closed on any winner or format mismatch. Outcome evidence writes back to the same winner.

outcome.truth_boundary: Implementation can be LIVE_PROVEN after protected merge, production migration/function deployment and exact production readback. A daily Instagram publication remains separately blocked until exact Mira media and provider proof exist.
